description: §44.3 — a `.prepare()` on a `?{}` result one block deep (inside an `if`) in a `kind="tool"` main SHALL be compile error E-SQL-006. Before s456 the diagnostic travelled on a channel the `if` body's emit options did not carry: exit 0, and only the runtime-throwing IIFE in the artifact.
rationale: §44.3 mandates `.prepare()` on a `?{}` result be a compile error; §2.2.1 forbids a silent stub in place of a hard diagnostic. Neither depends on the block nesting of the call.
